architecture_findings.claim: The donor component named EffectGate is nonblocking audit/admission bookkeeping for ordinary tool calls; it cannot receive pre-side-effect containment credit.
Completion proof uses a legacy status predicate that can accept current non-success effect states and an unbound textual test:0 assertion.
Effect correlation currently relies on mutable session-scoped active_turns.effect_id despite call-scoped tool_use_id availability; exact runtime race remains unexecuted.
PostTool file/process verification is bounded execution-result evidence and must remain distinct from arbitrary world-effect verification.

frankenstein_2_contract_delta.invocation_identity: Use immutable tool_use_id or equivalently exact invocation_id as the primary effect lifecycle key; session_id is context only.
frankenstein_2_contract_delta.enforcement: Blocking credit requires exact pre-side-effect host enforcement and invocation-bound allow/deny receipt; bookkeeping status alone is not enforcement.
frankenstein_2_contract_delta.completion: Only typed, generation/provenance-bound success receipts may close work. DENIED, FAILED, UNCHECKED, UNKNOWN, stale, duplicate-unresolved and unbound textual claims fail closed.
frankenstein_2_contract_delta.world_effect: Successful tool return does not mint arbitrary external-world truth; unknown external outcome remains UNKNOWN until effect-appropriate verification re-enters canonical state.
frankenstein_2_contract_delta.parallel_calls: Parallel calls require independent per-invocation lifecycle state; no shared mutable current-effect slot.

contradictions_preserved: EntityOS real-effect authority requires deterministic enforcement, but donor stern.py EffectGate explicitly does not block ordinary tools.
Completion comments promise stricter Phase-2 behavior while executable legacy status checking remains weaker.
The host-only wache-koenig blocking predecessor is referenced but its exact artifact/config/order remain unresolved.

namespace_resolution.resolution: Bridge by immutable provenance-bound packet; neither projection becomes canonical runtime truth or a second EntityOS state authority.
namespace_resolution.duplicate_policy: Main feed run IDs remain source provenance; owner-branch packet is consumed once by packet_id and does not claim independent replication.

mandatory: real pre-side-effect enforcement adapter with bound ALLOW/DENY receipts
execution receipt separated from world-effect verification
UNKNOWN preserved for unresolved external outcomes

next_exact_gate: Acquire exact wache-koenig/global-hook artifact or preserve the source hole; execute a harmless same-session overlapping-call falsifier on an authorized non-provider surface only when Triggerword-4/runtime authority permits; then bind observed invocation lifecycle into the executor effect contract.
